name: The Staircase [Alpha v1.14]
desc:
[IN ALPHA, BEWARE OF BUGS!!!]

Version 1.15a

The Staircase is a remaster inspired by SCP-087 and The Haunted Staircase on Roblox. Descend an endless concrete stairwell where strange sounds 🔊, darkness 🌑, and unexplained events occur the deeper you go. 

For the best experience: 🎧
– Play with headphones or sound on 
– Use higher graphics settings for lighting and effects ✨
– Play with friends or alone in a quiet environment 🚪

Warnings: ⚠️
– Dark environments 🌘
– Psychological horror elements 🧠
– Sudden loud sounds and unsettling moments 😨

This is a slow-paced horror experience. Proceed carefully.
